governing_rule: Clause V2-SEC-4: Any case involving exported customer data to an external destination must be denied unless a security-approved override explicitly names that exact destination and exact use case.
conflicting_signals: Manager-approved internal exports for debugging may be approved if the dataset stays within the company boundary (V1-EXP-2).
Manager note approves temporary override for exporting sanitized billing samples to the analytics sandbox mirror for incident review tied to fraud-model drift.
The manager note is not countersigned by security, so the formal v2 clause takes precedence (V2-SEC-5).
reason: The case involves exported customer data to an external destination. The manager note does not match the exact use case (vendor escalation vs fraud-model drift incident review) and is not countersigned by security, so V2-SEC-4 applies and requires denial.
